scope: Linux MIT RPCSEC_GSS v1: seven real KDC groups including 15 unmodified pynfs cases; AUTH_SYS core/namespace/ACL regressions. Native kernel and remote sanitizer results pending. Windows GSS acceptor and Full SMB/NFS remain incomplete.

checks: real MIT tickets: mutual authentication and NFSv3/v4.1 read/write in krb5, krb5i and krb5p; AUTH_SYS downgrade denied; MOUNT and SECINFO advertise Kerberos
header/body MIC and encrypted-body tampering rejected; 64-entry replay window drops duplicates/old requests and accepts out-of-order requests; MAXSEQ and body sequence enforced
v3 duplicate mutation with fresh GSS sequence replays its result and rechecks revoked authority; context survives TCP reconnect; authenticated DESTROY invalidates the handle
unmapped principals and wrong acceptor tickets denied; per-export privacy requirement prevents downgrade; existing contexts lose access after principal mapping revocation
unmodified pinned pynfs COMP1, CSESS1, OPEN1, OPEN30 and VF1r pass using krb5, krb5i and krb5p
atomic service-key rotation accepts newly issued tickets while established contexts continue; live group-membership revocation denies existing contexts
expired tickets and pre-restart context handles are rejected; fresh mutual authentication preserves access to stable file handles
TCP record fragmentation and MOUNT v3 with independent XDR codecs
unknown UID/GID/groups rejected; root squashed to explicitly unprivileged subject
root squash uses anonymous read rights, strips privileged groups and rejects writes/revoked rights
read-only TCP portmapper advertises NFS and does not advertise unsupported NLM version 3
trailing XDR rejected before WRITE; previously persisted bytes remain intact
v3 guarded CREATE, 64 KiB UNSTABLE upgraded to FILE_SYNC, READ, COMMIT, exact duplicate WRITE
MAC tamper rejected; file handle survives external rename and all-service restart; durable v3 replay and new write verifier
deleted/recreated path cannot revive an old file handle
v3 MKDIR, cross-directory RENAME, READDIRPLUS, REMOVE/RMDIR type separation
pynfs v4.1 EXCHANGE_ID/CREATE_SESSION/SEQUENCE, guarded OPEN, WRITE/READ, exact slot replay
false slot replay and foreign stateid rejected; GETATTR subset independently decoded
old sessions/stateids invalidated on reboot; persisted owner can reclaim OPEN during grace; CLOSE releases recovery record
unrelated client cannot reclaim another owner after restart
export disable revokes existing handles through fresh identity grants
offline metadata backup strips NFS enrollment and excludes persistent capability/recovery databases
paged pseudo-root READDIR exposes only enabled, mapped and authorized exports; returned handles match LOOKUP and LOOKUPP
root-squashed, unmapped and invalid-group identities cannot enumerate protected names; invalid attributes reject even in empty directories
READDIR validates reserved cookies, changed verifiers, exact maxcount and forward progress; pseudo-root change and SECINFO work
one session holds simultaneous OPENs in distinct exports and executes cross-export compounds without accepting mismatched stateids
cached compound replies reauthorize every touched export, including READ without OPEN; revocation prevents data replay while other exports remain usable
cached pseudo-root listings are fenced when export visibility changes and the next slot sequence still progresses
retargeting a share with the same export UUID cannot authorize a cached response from the old space
NFSv3 mode is enforced, owner/group are mapped, nonowner chmod denied; NFSv4 advertises real ACL support
group mode checks use only verified AUTH_SYS groups; omitted groups and root-squashed groups cannot grant access
ACL+mode applies mode then ACL; named-user ACE roundtrips, READ_ACL is enforced and chmod masks named grants
invalid ACL principal and flags fail before truncation; empty ACL denies data and owner can recover WRITE_ACL
special/named groups and primary-group changes enforce the mapped trustee; opaque SMB SIDs roundtrip; execute-only NFS READ/OPEN/ACCESS works; invalid CREATE ACL leaves no object
directory ACL inheritance preserves OWNER@ and clears the acl-only inherited flag; ACL attributes larger than 4 KiB roundtrip
NFS chmod and ACL changes govern new SMB opens of the same object
shared ACLs, symbolic principals and derived mode survive complete service restart

note: The earlier 15-group AUTH_SYS run preceded the final GSS-only replay-authority and pseudo-root flavor changes; final AUTH_SYS core (68), namespace (7) and ACL (8) ran after those changes.
